title: Zhengzhou Exceed New Technologies Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Zhengzhou Exceed New Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Henan-based insulation materials manufacturer integrating research, production, and sales. The company supplies aerogel and adjacent insulation materials for industrial, construction, and thermal-management applications, and positions itself as one of the larger insulation-material companies in North China.

Company Overview

The company’s public site highlights aerogel blankets, powders, coatings, and battery heat-insulation sheets alongside other thermal-insulation materials. It serves domestic and overseas markets with a broad product offering aimed at industry, construction, and equipment protection.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China and dozens of overseas markets.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, building insulation, battery heat insulation, and integrated thermal-insulation materials.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel powders and aerogel particles
  • Aerogel blankets for industrial, construction, and battery use
  • Aerogel coatings and aerogel insulating plaster
  • Vacuum insulation panels and related thermal materials
  • Public Capacity: More than 8 million sqm annually.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Zhengzhou, Henan, China; public contact address listed as No. 9 SuoLing Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.
  • International Certifications: ISO 9001 and EN 12667 are publicly referenced, alongside product safety data and air-shipping certification materials.
  • Official Website: https://www.exceedinsulation.com/
